title: AeroSpace
description: Dominate your map's skyline with the ultimate white-knuckle thrill ride! Based on the massive real-world KMG giant booster, the AeroSpace stands at an incredible 65 meters tall and swings riders at speeds up to 120 km/h. Featuring a highly detailed model, realistic fold-out assembly animations, and a breathtaking custom night-lighting system, this is the perfect centerpiece for your Farming Simulator funfair layout.

title: Airwolf
description: Add a rare piece of fairground history to your map with the Airwolf. Based on the massive, classic Mondial Inferno engineering design, this unique attraction features a heavy counterweighted main arm that lifts passengers up to 25 meters. While the main arm turns, the two large individual passenger pods on either side rotate and tilt independently to deliver a high-amplitude, multi-axis ride experience.

title: Aqua Blaster
description: Add a classic, water-themed midway attraction to your funfair setup. The Aqua Blaster is a self-contained game trailer featuring a decorated, themed cabinet equipped with four interactive water cannons and a lower water reservoir basin. Its compact footprint makes it the perfect choice for filling small gaps or lining the walkways of your local event layout.

title: Around The World
description: Dominate your regional showgrounds with the Around the World vertical swing tower. Based on the giant, transportable tower design by Funtime, this massive asset features a towering central lattice mast and a rotating star-shaped collar. It lifts open-air, double-seat passenger carriages high above the ground, creating a commanding vertical landmark for your map's entertainment district.

title: Avengers
description: Add an intense, looping attraction to your fairground layout with the Avengers. Based on the KMG pendulum design, this asset features a long main arm that performs full 360-degree overhead loops. The passenger capsule at the base of the arm rotates freely as it swings, offering a highly dynamic multi-axis movement profile and a commanding structural presence on any map.

title: Aviator
description: Bring the high-speed thrill of the modern Dutch show circuit to your map. Based on the "Remix" platform engineered by Tivoli, the Aviator features a central rotating hub with 4 powerful hydraulic arms. Each arm holds independent passenger pods that spin wildly while the main assembly lifts and tilts, delivering a rapid, multi-axis ride profile with a compact footprint.

title: Air
description: Take your fairground map to new heights with the iconic Air thrill ride. Based on the rare real-world Zierer Star Shape attraction, this massive machine lifts passengers nearly 30 meters into the sky on a giant rotating arm. At the peak, the star-shaped seating clusters spin and flip freely, creating a high-energy centerpiece that dominates any local showground layout.

title: AFC-Skooter
description: No funfair is complete without the timeless tradition of the bumper cars! The AFC-Skooter brings a full-sized, transportable dodgem track to your map. It features a beautifully illuminated pavilion, a fleet of bumper cars.

title: Alpinabahn
description: Bring one of the largest portable steel roller coasters in the world to your map. Based on the legendary Schwarzkopf-designed attraction, the Alpina Bahn features a massive, multi-tiered structural footprint. The layout delivers a fast, inversion-free family ride experience characterized by a 27-meter drop, signature tight helices, and continuous diving curves.

title: Air One Max
description: Bring high-octane thrills to your fairground with the Air One Maxx! Based on the famous KMG Sicko attraction, this high-performance pendulum ride features outward-facing suspended seating that wildly spins while the massive main arm swings riders up to a 120-degree angle.
